title: KET 阅读题型专项（全原创题）

part1.name: Part 1 · 短文本抓主旨
part1.desc: 6 篇简短真实场景文本（告示/短信/便条/标志），每篇 1 题三选一

items.text:
GYM
Wet floor today!
PE lessons move to the playground.
items.q: Where are PE lessons today?
items.explain: move to the playground = 改到操场。

items.text: Ana — I took your maths book by mistake. It's in my bag. Come to Class 2 at lunch to get it. Rita
items.q: What should Ana do?
options: Look for the book in her bag.
Go to Class 2 at lunch time.
items.explain: Come to Class 2 at lunch。

items.text:
SCHOOL LUNCH
Monday: noodles
Tuesday: rice & fish
No hot food on Friday — bring a sandwich.
items.q: What happens on Friday?
items.explain: No hot food on Friday。

items.text:
LOST: small black cat, white ears.
Last seen near the school gate.
Call Ms Park, Room 5.
items.q: What is this notice about?
options: A cat that needs a home.
items.explain: LOST = 走失。

items.text: Class 6: tomorrow's test moves from 9 am to 11 am. Same room. Bring two pencils.
items.q: What has changed about the test?
items.explain: 9 点改 11 点，只有时间变了。

items.text:
QUIET PLEASE
Exams in the hall this week.
Use the back stairs.
items.q: Why must students be quiet?
options: There are exams in the hall.
items.explain: Exams in the hall this week。

items.text:
BUS 12
Does not stop here on Sundays.
Please use Bus 15 from Green Street.
items.q: What should you do on Sundays?
items.explain: 周日 12 路不停这站，改乘 Green Street 的 15 路。

items.text: Lin — Your piano teacher called. Tomorrow's lesson is one hour earlier, at 4 pm. Don't be late! Mum
items.q: When is the piano lesson tomorrow?
items.explain: 提前一小时后是 4 点。

items.text:
POOL TICKETS
Adults £3, children £1.
Family ticket (2 adults + 2 children): £6
items.q: How much is a family ticket?
items.explain: Family ticket: £6。

items.text: Ben! My cousins are here so I can't play football today. Can we play tomorrow after school instead? Joe
items.q: Why can't Joe play today?
items.explain: My cousins are here。

items.text:
SORRY!
No bread until 10 am today.
Cakes and juice as usual.
items.q: What can you buy at 9 am?
items.explain: 面包 10 点才有，蛋糕果汁照常。

items.text:
THE SPACE DOG 2
Today's 3 pm film is full.
Tickets left for 5 pm and 7 pm.
items.q: Which film can you still watch?
items.explain: 3 点满了，5 点和 7 点还有票。

items.text:
ORCHESTRA MEMBERS
Extra practice on Saturday 9-11 am for next week's concert. Everyone must come.
items.q: What is this notice about?
items.explain: Extra practice… Everyone must come。

items.text:
BOOK WEEK
Write about your favourite book (100 words) and win a £20 book ticket! Give it to Mr Hall by Friday.
items.q: How can you win the prize?
options: By writing about a book you like.
items.explain: 写一篇 100 词的favourite book 短文。

items.text: Sweetie, I made too many cakes today! Come after school and take some home for Mum and Dad. Grandma
items.q: Why did Grandma write?
options: She wants to give some cakes away.
She wants to visit after school.
items.explain: 蛋糕做多了，让孩子带回家。

items.text:
FREE MUSIC IN THE PARK
Every Sunday in June, 2-4 pm.
Bring something to sit on!
items.q: What should visitors bring?
items.explain: Bring something to sit on。

items.text:
ART HOMEWORK
Draw your family. Use colour! Give it in on Thursday, not Friday — Miss Ray is away Friday.
items.q: When is the homework due?
items.explain: Give it in on Thursday。

items.text: I fed your fish because you were at violin. It ate a lot! You owe me one ice cream. Kai
items.q: What did Kai do?
options: He gave food to the fish.
items.explain: fed your fish = 喂了鱼。

items.text:
QUIET CARRIAGE
No phone calls or loud music.
Please speak quietly.
items.q: What can you do in this carriage?
items.explain: speak quietly 可以，打电话和外放不行。

items.text: TOY SHOP — now on Floor 3 (next to the bookshop). The Floor 1 shop is now a café.
items.q: Where is the toy shop now?
items.explain: now on Floor 3。

items.text: Your taxi will arrive at 7.50, ten minutes late — sorry! Driver: Mr Chen, white car, number 88.
items.q: What time was the taxi first going to come?
items.explain: 7:50 是晚了 10 分钟之后 → 原定 7:40。

items.text:
SPORTS SHOES SALE
Buy one pair, get a second pair half price. Ends Sunday!
items.q: What does the notice mean?
items.explain: 第二双半价。

items.text:
FLIGHT CA88 to Beijing
Now leaves 21.10 (not 20.30)
Gate B7 (not B2)
items.q: What is true about flight CA88?
options: It leaves from a different gate.
items.explain: 登机口 B2 改 B7；时间是推迟不是提前。

items.text:
FRESH MILK
2 bottles for £2
(1 bottle: £1.40)
items.q: How can you pay less for milk?
items.explain: 两瓶 2 镑比单瓶 1.4 镑合算。

items.text: Hi Mia! This is a message from Dr Lo's office. Your 4 pm visit tomorrow is now 3 pm. Reply YES if this is OK.
items.q: What should Mia do if 3 pm is fine?
items.explain: Reply YES。

items.text:
TO ALL NEIGHBOURS
No water on Tuesday 9 am - 2 pm (pipe work).
Please keep some water ready.
items.q: What should people do before Tuesday?
items.explain: keep some water ready = 提前存水。

items.text: Reminder: school photo day is Wednesday! Wear your school jacket. Smile practice not needed 😄 — Mr Kim
items.q: What must students wear on Wednesday?
items.explain: Wear your school jacket。

items.text:
PLEASE DO NOT FEED THE DUCKS BREAD.
It is bad for them. Duck food: £1 at the gate shop.
items.q: What does the sign ask people to do?
options: Not give bread to the ducks.
items.explain: 不能喂面包；门口有专用鸭粮。

items.text: Gone running. Back at 8. Your breakfast is on the table — eat the egg while it's warm! Dad
items.q: Where is Dad?
items.explain: Gone running = 跑步去了。

items.text:
VISITING HOURS
Monday-Friday: 3-8 pm
Weekends: 10 am - 8 pm
Children under 12 must come with an adult.
items.q: When can you visit on Saturday?
items.explain: 周末 10 点开始。

part2.name: Part 2 · 多项匹配
part2.desc: 7 个问题 + 3 篇同主题短文，判断谁/哪篇符合

profiles.label: A
profiles.title: Dana
profiles.text: I play the flute. It is light, so I take it everywhere — I even played it on a mountain last summer! I practise in the morning before school because my evenings are full of homework.

profiles.label: B
profiles.title: Eric
profiles.text: My instrument is the cello. It is big and heavy, so Dad drives me to my lessons. I started when I was five. Last month I played alone on stage for the first time and I wasn't scared at all.

profiles.label: C
profiles.title: Fay
profiles.text: I play the drums! My parents bought me quiet electric drums because our flat is small. I watch videos to learn new beats and dream of starting a band with my cousins.

questions.q: Who practises early in the day?
questions.explain: in the morning before school。

questions.q: Who needs help to carry the instrument?
questions.explain: 大提琴又大又重，爸爸开车送。

questions.q: Who learns from videos?
questions.explain: watch videos to learn new beats。

questions.q: Who played outdoors in an unusual place?
questions.explain: 在山上吹过长笛。

questions.q: Who performed alone recently?
questions.explain: played alone on stage last month。

questions.q: Whose instrument makes little noise?
questions.explain: quiet electric drums。

questions.q: Who wants to make music with family members?
questions.explain: a band with my cousins。

profiles.label: A
profiles.title: Gus
profiles.text: We went camping by a lake. Dad and I caught two fish and cooked them on a fire. At night we heard an owl. I lost my hat in the water, but it was still the best week ever.

profiles.label: B
profiles.title: Holly
profiles.text: I stayed in the city with Aunt Vera. We visited the big art museum twice because I loved it so much. She bought me a painting set, and I drew the tall buildings from her window.

profiles.label: C
profiles.title: Ivan
profiles.text: My family flew to an island. The sea was warm and full of little blue fish. I built the biggest sand castle on the beach. On the last day it rained, so we played cards in the hotel.

questions.q: Who travelled by plane?
questions.explain: flew to an island。

questions.q: Who cooked outside?
questions.explain: cooked them on a fire。

questions.q: Who went to the same place two times?
questions.explain: visited the museum twice。

questions.q: Who lost something?
questions.explain: lost my hat in the water。

questions.q: Who got a present?
questions.explain: bought me a painting set。

questions.q: Who stayed inside because of the weather?
questions.explain: it rained… played cards in the hotel。

questions.q: Who heard an animal at night?
questions.explain: heard an owl 猫头鹰。

profiles.label: A
profiles.title: Swim Stars
profiles.text: Swim Stars meets on Monday and Thursday evenings at the town pool. New swimmers do a short test first. The class costs £5 a week, and you get a free swim cap when you join.

profiles.label: B
profiles.title: Kick It
profiles.text: Kick It is a football club for ages 9-12 on Saturday mornings in West Park. It is free! Just bring boots and water. When it rains hard, the coach sends a message and practice moves to the school gym.

profiles.label: C
profiles.title: Ping Pong Plus
profiles.text: We play table tennis every day at lunch time in the school hall. Beginners are welcome — old players teach new players. Once a month we have a small competition with chocolate prizes!

questions.q: Which club costs nothing?
questions.explain: It is free!

questions.q: Which club gives you something free when you start?
questions.explain: a free swim cap when you join。

questions.q: Which club meets most often?
questions.explain: every day at lunch time。

questions.q: Where do new members take a test?
questions.explain: New swimmers do a short test first。

questions.q: Which club sometimes changes its place?
questions.explain: 大雨时改到学校体育馆。

questions.q: Where can you win something sweet?
questions.explain: chocolate prizes。

questions.q: In which club do students teach each other?
questions.explain: old players teach new players。

profiles.label: A
profiles.title: Jade
profiles.text: My rabbit Biscuit lives in the garden. He is four years old. He loves carrot tops more than carrots! Every evening he runs to the kitchen door and waits for me to come and play.

profiles.label: B
profiles.title: Ken
profiles.text: I keep six little fish. They are orange and silver. I clean their tank every Sunday — it takes an hour, but I like doing it. My favourite fish always swims to the glass when I come near.

profiles.label: C
profiles.title: Lara
profiles.text: My dog Pepper is one year old and full of energy. We walk before school and after dinner, in all weather! She once ate my homework — really! My teacher laughed and gave me one more day.

questions.q: Whose pet lives outside?
questions.explain: lives in the garden。

questions.q: Who has the youngest pet?
questions.explain: Pepper is one year old（兔子 4 岁）。

questions.q: Who has more than one pet?
questions.explain: six little fish。

questions.q: Who does a cleaning job for the pet every week?
questions.explain: clean their tank every Sunday。

questions.q: Whose pet caused a school problem?
questions.explain: ate my homework。

questions.q: Whose pet waits at the same place every day?
questions.explain: runs to the kitchen door and waits。

questions.q: Who goes out with the pet twice a day?
questions.explain: before school and after dinner。

profiles.label: A
profiles.title: Mo
profiles.text: For my birthday, we went to the science museum with three friends. We watched a show about stars and lay on the floor to see the whole sky! Mum made a moon cake — not the Chinese kind, a cake like the moon!

profiles.label: B
profiles.title: Nina
profiles.text: I had a garden party. Dad cooked on the fire outside and we played hide and seek until dark. My best present was a red bike from my grandparents. I ride it to school now.

profiles.label: C
profiles.title: Omar
profiles.text: My birthday was on a school day, so we celebrated on the weekend. We saw a film about a singing lion, then ate pizza. My little sister paid for my ice cream with her own pocket money — so sweet!

questions.q: Whose birthday party was at home?
questions.explain: a garden party 在自家花园。

questions.q: Who celebrated later than the real birthday?
questions.explain: 生日在上学日，周末才庆祝。

questions.q: Who watched something about space?
questions.explain: a show about stars。

questions.q: Who got a present they use every day?
questions.explain: ride it to school now。

questions.q: Whose family member spent their own money?
questions.explain: 妹妹用零花钱买冰淇淋。

questions.q: Who ate something that looked like the moon?
questions.explain: a cake like the moon。

questions.q: Who played a game outside in the evening?
questions.explain: hide and seek until dark。

part3.name: Part 3 · 长文理解
part3.desc: 一篇 150-200 词长文 + 5 题三选一（细节与主旨）

sets.title: Grandpa's Garden
sets.passage:
My grandpa has a small garden behind his house, and he says it is his best friend. Every morning before breakfast, he walks between the plants and talks to them! Mum laughs at him, but Grandpa says plants grow better when they hear a kind voice.
In spring, I help him plant tomatoes and beans. He never uses gloves because he likes to feel the earth. "Soft hands, soft heart," he always says. I don't really know what it means, but I like it.
The best time is summer. We pick tomatoes together, still warm from the sun, and eat them right there in the garden. They taste better than any tomatoes from a shop.
Last winter, Grandpa was ill for a month and could not go outside. I visited every weekend and watered everything for him. When he got better and saw his garden green and healthy, he didn't say anything. He just held my hand. Soft hands, I thought.

questions.q: What does Grandpa do every morning?
questions.explain: walks between the plants and talks to them。

questions.q: Why does Grandpa work without gloves?
options: He wants to touch the earth.
questions.explain: he likes to feel the earth。

questions.q: Why do the summer tomatoes taste special?
options: They come from a good shop.
They are eaten fresh in the garden.
questions.explain: 刚摘的、带着太阳温度、当场吃。

questions.q: What happened last winter?
options: Grandpa could not leave the house.
questions.explain: ill for a month and could not go outside。

questions.q: How did Grandpa feel at the end?
questions.explain: 没说话只是握手——无声的感谢。

sets.title: The Night Market
sets.passage:
Once a month in summer, our town has a night market by the river. It opens when the sky gets dark and the street lights come on. My parents let me stay up late for it — it is the only night I go to bed after ten!
You can smell the market before you see it: sweet corn, fried noodles, and hot sugar. My favourite stand sells little fish-shaped cakes with chocolate inside. The man there knows me now and always gives me one extra.
There is music too. Students from the university play guitars near the bridge, and people put coins in their guitar case. Last time, my little brother danced in front of everyone, and a woman gave him a coin too! He wants to go back every night now.
Mum buys vegetables and cheap bowls; Dad just eats. Me? I like walking slowly through the lights and sounds, holding my warm fish cake. The market closes at midnight, but I never see it close — I am always asleep in the car long before that.

questions.q: How often is the night market?
options: One time each month in summer.
questions.explain: Once a month in summer。

questions.q: What is special about the writer's favourite food?
questions.explain: fish-shaped cakes 鱼形小蛋糕，巧克力馅。

questions.q: Why did a woman give the brother a coin?
options: He danced in front of people.
questions.explain: danced in front of everyone。

questions.q: What does Dad do at the market?
questions.explain: Dad just eats。

questions.q: Why does the writer never see the market close?
options: The writer falls asleep before midnight.
questions.explain: always asleep in the car long before that。

sets.title: Twins
sets.passage:
Ada and Ida are twins in my class, and for two years I could not tell them apart. Same brown eyes, same short hair, same way of laughing with their heads back. Even our teacher sometimes called Ada "Ida" and Ida "Ada". The twins never got angry; they just answered to both names.
But this year I learned their secret differences. Ada writes with her left hand and always has ink on her little finger. Ida draws tiny stars in the corner of her notebooks. Ada is afraid of dogs but loves thunder; Ida is the opposite — she runs to the window when a dog walks by, and hides under the desk in a storm.
Last week, a new boy joined our class and asked me, "How do you know who is who?" I told him: "You don't have to know. Just be their friend, and one day you will see two different people." He looked at me strangely. But he will understand, like I did.

questions.q: For a long time, how did the writer feel about the twins?
options: They were impossible to tell apart.
questions.explain: could not tell them apart。

questions.q: What did the twins do when people mixed their names?
questions.explain: just answered to both names。

questions.q: How can you know Ada by looking at her hand?
options: She has ink on a finger.
questions.explain: 左手写字，小指沾墨水。

questions.q: What does Ida do when there is thunder?
options: She laughs with her head back.
questions.explain: hides under the desk in a storm。

questions.q: What is the writer's advice to the new boy?
questions.explain: Just be their friend…。

sets.topic: 长文 · 我们的乐团去比赛
sets.title: The Big Competition
sets.passage:
Last month, our school orchestra travelled to the city for a young musicians' competition. Forty children, twelve violins, one very heavy drum kit and Mr Tan, our conductor, all went in one bus. Mr Tan sang funny songs the whole way, maybe because he was more nervous than us.
The concert hall was the biggest room I have ever seen. Our shoes made little squeaky sounds on the shiny floor. When the team before us finished, everyone clapped for a long time, and my hands went cold. "They are so good," whispered my friend Yu.
Then something surprising happened. Mr Tan gathered us in a circle and said, "Forget the prize. Play for the bus ride home — let's make it a happy one." So we did. We played our three songs and I made one small mistake, but nobody stopped, and the last note filled the hall like warm water.
We came second. On the bus home, we sang all the way — and this time, Mr Tan just listened, smiling with his eyes closed.

questions.q: Why did Mr Tan probably sing on the way there?
questions.explain: maybe because he was more nervous than us。

questions.q: How did the writer feel after hearing the team before them?
questions.explain: 鼓掌很久+手发凉 → 紧张担心。

questions.q: What did Mr Tan tell the orchestra to do?
questions.explain: Forget the prize… make it a happy one。

questions.q: What happened when the writer made a mistake?
questions.explain: nobody stopped。

questions.q: What is the best title idea for the last part?
questions.explain: 得了第二名，却收获了最快乐的归程。

sets.title: The Corner Bookshop
sets.passage:
There is a little bookshop on the corner of our street, between the bank and the flower shop. It is easy to walk past it — but don't, because inside it is bigger than it looks, with stairs going down to a room full of children's books.
The owner, Mrs Petrova, remembers what every child likes. When I was eight, she gave me my first mystery book. "Careful," she said, "mysteries eat your sleep." She was right. I read it under my blanket with a torch.
The shop has one strange rule: if you finish a book and bring it back with a short letter about it, you get half your money back for the next book. The wall behind Mrs Petrova is covered with hundreds of these letters, some from children who are now grown up with children of their own.
Last Saturday, I added my ninth letter to the wall. Mrs Petrova read it, smiled, and said, "One more, and you get a special prize." I already know what I want: the big blue book of sea stories in the window. Five more days of reading. I had better start tonight.

questions.q: What is surprising about the shop?
options: It is larger inside than it looks.
questions.explain: bigger than it looks + 地下室。

questions.q: What did Mrs Petrova mean by "mysteries eat your sleep"?
options: You will read instead of sleeping.
questions.explain: 看得停不下来，睡觉时间都被吃掉——作者果然打着手电看。

questions.q: How can children pay less for their next book?
options: By writing about the last book.
questions.explain: 带书回来+写一封短信 → 半价。

questions.q: What do the letters on the wall show?
options: The shop is very old and loved.
questions.explain: 几百封信，有的作者已长大成家——老店与爱。

questions.q: What will the writer probably do tonight?
questions.explain: I had better start tonight = 今晚开始读。

part4.name: Part 4 · 多选完形
part4.desc: 一篇说明文 + 6 空三选一，以词汇为主

sets.title: Busy Bees
sets.passage: Bees are small but very important. They fly from flower to flower and (1) ___ sweet honey for us. One bee family can be very big — up to sixty thousand bees (2) ___ together in one home! Every bee has a job. Some look for food, some clean, and some (3) ___ the baby bees. When a bee finds good flowers, it does a little (4) ___ to tell the others where to go. Bees work all summer to (5) ___ food for the cold months. Without bees, we would have much (6) ___ fruit to eat, so we should be kind to them.

gaps.explain: make honey 酿蜜。
住在一起 → live together。
照顾幼蜂 → look after。
蜜蜂用「舞蹈」传递方向。
为冬天存粮 → keep food。
没有蜜蜂水果会少得多 → much less。

sets.topic: 完形 · 自行车的历史
sets.title: Two Wheels
sets.passage: The first bicycles were very (1) ___ from the bikes we ride today. They were made of wood and had no pedals — riders pushed the ground with their (2) ___! Later, bikes got one huge front wheel. They were fast but not (3) ___, and riders often fell. About one hundred and forty years ago, bikes with two same-size wheels arrived, and soon everybody wanted one. Today, millions of people (4) ___ their bikes to school or work. Riding is cheap, quiet and good for your (5) ___. In some cities you can even (6) ___ a city bike with a phone and leave it anywhere.

gaps.explain: different from 与…不同。
没有脚踏板，用脚蹬地。
快但不安全，常摔倒。
ride a bike 骑车。
good for your health。
用手机取用共享单车 → take。

sets.topic: 完形 · 图书馆的一天
sets.title: A Day at the Library
sets.passage: Our town library is not just a place for books. In the morning, little children come with their parents to (1) ___ to story time. At lunch, students sit in the quiet room and (2) ___ their homework. There is a computer room where old people learn to send emails to their grandchildren — the young librarian (3) ___ them patiently. On Friday afternoons there is a chess club, and you can (4) ___ the games even if you don't play. Best of all, everything is (5) ___ — you never pay. You only need a library card, and you can get one in five (6) ___.

gaps.explain: listen to story time 听故事会。
do homework 固定搭配。
图书管理员耐心帮助他们。
不下棋也可以看 → watch the games。
全部免费 → everything is free。
五分钟就能办卡。

sets.title: What Is Sound?
sets.passage: Put your hand on your throat and say "aaah". Can you feel it moving? Sound is made when something moves very fast, again and again. Musicians use this idea every (1) ___. When you pull a guitar string, it moves and makes the air (2) ___ it move too. The moving air travels to your (3) ___ like small waves on water. Big, slow waves make (4) ___ sounds, like a drum. Small, fast waves make high sounds, like a little (5) ___. In space there is no air, so there are no waves and no sound at all. That is why films about space should really be (6) ___!

gaps.explain: every day 每天都在用这个原理。
琴弦让周围的空气也动起来。
声波传到耳朵。
大而慢的波 → 低音（鼓）。
高音像小鸟叫。
太空没有声音，电影本该是安静的。

sets.title: The First Meal
sets.passage: Many doctors say breakfast is the most important (1) ___ of the day. After a long night, your body is like a car with an empty tank — it needs something before it can (2) ___ well. Children who eat a good breakfast often (3) ___ better marks at school because it is easier for them to think. A good breakfast does not need to be big. An egg, some bread and a (4) ___ of milk are enough. Try not to eat too many sweet things in the morning: they wake you up fast, but soon you feel (5) ___ again. And here is a nice idea: get everything ready the night (6) ___, and you can sleep ten more minutes!

gaps.explain: 一天中最重要的一餐 → meal。
身体需要能量才能好好运转 → work well。
get better marks 取得更好成绩。
一杯牛奶 → a glass of milk。
糖分让你快醒也快累 → tired。
the night before 前一天晚上。

part5.name: Part 5 · 开放完形（语法小词，6 分可速成）
part5.desc: 一封 A2 邮件 6 空，每空填一词无选项，答案全是 1-3 个字母的小词，拼写必须正确

sets.passage:
Hi Anna,
